title: Module homology as an explicit kernel modulo boundary image
statement: Let A be a ring and S a short complex of A-modules with consecutive maps a,b and b composed with a zero [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. There are canonical isomorphisms moduleCatCyclesIso from S.cycles to ker(b), and moduleCatHomologyIso from S.homology to ker(b) modulo the range of a corestricted to ker(b). The cycles inclusion agrees under moduleCatCyclesIso with the kernel inclusion. The equation π_moduleCatCyclesIso_hom identifies S.homologyPi followed by moduleCatHomologyIso.hom with moduleCatCyclesIso.hom followed by the quotient projection; moduleCatCyclesIso_inv_π gives its inverse form.
